points.title: 幼年登基与辅政时期
points.description: 顺治帝去世后，年仅八岁的玄烨继位，年号康熙。初期由索尼、苏克萨哈、遏必隆、鳌拜四位辅政大臣辅政。1669年，康熙帝以智谋铲除专权的鳌拜，开始亲政。
points.descriptionEn: After the death of the Shunzhi Emperor, the eight-year-old Xuanye ascended the throne with the era name Kangxi. Initially, four regents—Sonin, Suksaha, Ebilun, and Oboi—managed state affairs. In 1669, the Kangxi Emperor outmaneuvered the domineering Oboi and began personal rule.

points.title: 平定三藩之乱
points.description: 康熙帝决定撤藩，引发吴三桂、尚可喜、耿精忠等藩王叛乱。经过八年战争，清廷于1681年平定三藩之乱，巩固了中央集权。
points.descriptionEn: The Kangxi Emperor's decision to abolish the feudatories triggered a rebellion led by Wu Sangui, Shang Kexi, and Geng Jingzhong. After eight years of war, the Qing court suppressed the Revolt of the Three Feudatories in 1681, consolidating central authority.

points.title: 统一台湾与长期统治
points.titleEn: Unification of Taiwan and Long Reign
points.description: 1683年，清军攻占台湾，郑氏政权投降，清朝将台湾纳入版图。此后康熙帝在位期间，进行多方面的治理与扩张，包括与俄国签订《尼布楚条约》、亲征噶尔丹等，直至1722年去世。
points.descriptionEn: In 1683, Qing forces captured Taiwan, and the Zheng regime surrendered, incorporating Taiwan into the Qing empire. During the subsequent reign, the Kangxi Emperor undertook various administrative and military initiatives, including the Treaty of Nerchinsk with Russia and personal campaigns against Galdan, until his death in 1722.

supporter.zh: 支持者认为康熙帝是清朝最有作为的皇帝之一，他巩固了多民族国家的统一，奠定了清朝盛世的根基，在政治、军事和文化上均有建树。
supporter.en: Supporters regard the Kangxi Emperor as one of the most accomplished rulers of the Qing dynasty, crediting him with consolidating a multi-ethnic state, laying the foundation for the Qing golden age, and achieving notable successes in politics, military, and culture.

critic.zh: 批评者指出康熙帝时期存在文字狱、海禁等政策，对思想自由和沿海经济造成限制，且晚年吏治腐败、储位之争激烈。
critic.en: Critics point to policies such as literary inquisitions and maritime bans during his reign, which restricted intellectual freedom and coastal economies, as well as corruption in later years and fierce succession disputes.

objective.zh: 客观而言，康熙帝在位六十一年，是中国历史上在位时间最长的皇帝之一。他平定了内乱，统一了台湾，抵抗了沙俄的扩张，并推动了文化事业，但其统治也伴随着专制强化和社会控制。
objective.en: Objectively, the Kangxi Emperor reigned for sixty-one years, one of the longest in Chinese history. He suppressed internal rebellions, unified Taiwan, resisted Russian expansion, and promoted cultural endeavors, though his rule also involved strengthened autocracy and social control.

others.zh: 同时代法国传教士白晋称康熙帝为「伟大而仁慈的君主」，但此类评价带有个人观察色彩。
others.en: The contemporary French missionary Joachim Bouvet described the Kangxi Emperor as 'a great and benevolent monarch,' though such assessments reflect personal observation.
